_about: Airbus A300F4-600 AC (Dec 01/09), 2.2 Airplane Dimensions, page 2 (page index 17): layers.py --mode image at scale 4.89, clip 60,355,560,570 (front): the front view is drawn 2.3% larger than the side (its printed 44.84 m span between its extension lines), rendered to the side's scale. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). The A30B's points moved onto it (plug.py --shift -172,247) and snapped. The centerline is 918 px, the middle of the wing tips and of the two nacelles (the circle draws 5 px right of it, the fin 3 px left). The nacelles are drawn 16.5 m apart against the printed 15.88 m (the B2-B4 sheet draws its 15.87 m as printed, for the same wing): the inlet's ring, 106 px tall as drawn, is placed as free points about the printed 7.94 m out. The tailplane is drawn 16.9 m across, the A300B4's, against the printed 16.26 m: its span is taken from the print (stabilizerSpan).
